Senior Smart Contract Engineer — Ihsan Gold Token

Ihsan
$120k - $240k
Remote
 Apply

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Company: Ihsan

Product: Ihsan Gold Token

Website:https://ihsan.com/

Instagram:https://www.instagram.com/sultansamuelaziz/

YouTube:https://www.youtube.com/@sultansamuelaziz/

Core technologies: Solidity, TypeScript, EVM Base, Go, PostgreSQL, React Native, Rust


Who we are looking for

We are looking for a senior smart-contract and token engineer with real production experience building secure EVM-based financial infrastructure.

You understand smart-contract security, EVM token architecture, wallet infrastructure, secure signing, minting and burning, transaction monitoring, and the reliability requirements of systems that handle customer value.


About Ihsan

Ihsan is building the Digital Islamic Golden Age: a global ecosystem for the Ummah.

We begin with Ihsan Connect, an end-to-end encrypted messenger, and Ihsan Pay, a global riba-free payments system. Over time, Ihsan will bring together payments, commerce, work, communication, and financial tools designed around the needs and values of Muslims worldwide.

We are now building the Ihsan Gold Token, our gold-backed digital token.

  • 1 Ihsan Gold Token represents 1 gram of allocated physical gold.
  • Every token is backed by real gold held with a bullion and vault partner.
  • Users can buy and sell the token directly through the Ihsan app.
  • Approved users can send and receive the token between approved wallets on EVM Base.

The role

You will build the technical foundation of the Ihsan Gold Token. This includes Solidity smart contracts, token minting and burning, on-chain security, wallet and signing architecture, and reliable connections to our reserve and order systems.

This is a founding technical role. You will have real ownership over the architecture and security of a product where trust, accuracy, and operational discipline are essential.


What you will build

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain the Solidity smart contracts that govern the Ihsan Gold Token on EVM Base.
  • Create and configure the Ihsan Gold Token using secure, production-grade EVM token standards.
  • Design secure minting flows: no token may be minted until the matching gold allocation is confirmed.
  • Build secure burn and redemption flows.
  • Design a permissioned-transfer architecture, if transfers are limited to approved wallets.
  • Implement role-based access controls, allowlists or denylists, emergency pause procedures, and authority-management flows.
  • Design multisig, secure signing, key-management, and operational approval procedures.
  • Build reliable on-chain transaction flows for user-to-user transfers.
  • Ensure correct integration between the off-chain order and reserve ledger and on-chain mint and burn events.
  • Build deployment processes for testnet, staging, and mainnet.
  • Establish monitoring, indexing, alerting, reconciliation, and operational runbooks.
  • Help define the smart-contract security architecture, including independent audits and the decision between upgradeable and immutable contracts.

The core invariant

The total supply of Ihsan Gold Token must never exceed the amount of allocated physical gold held in custody.

Every mint, burn, reserve balance, wallet approval, and token supply figure must be continuously auditable.


What our wider team and partners handle

You will not be expected to build the entire financial product alone.

  • A bullion and vault partner will purchase, audit, and store the physical gold.
  • Our backend team will build broader app APIs, order flows, internal records, and operational tooling.
  • Our mobile team will build the customer experience.
  • Legal, licensing, KYC, AML, and compliance are handled separately.

Your responsibility is the secure smart-contract and token infrastructure, and its correct integration with the wider Ihsan system.


Required experience

  • Strong production experience designing and shipping secure Solidity smart contracts on EVM-compatible chains, ideally involving tokens, stablecoins, payments, wallets, or other customer-value systems.
  • Strong knowledge of ERC-20 and relevant token extensions, EVM security, wallets, transaction signing, RPC providers, and event indexing.
  • Experience implementing secure mint, burn, transfer-restriction, pause, allowlist/denylist, and role-based authority-management flows.
  • Strong understanding of multisig, MPC or hardware-backed signing, and secure key-management design.
  • Experience with financial ledgers, reconciliation, payments, wallets, stablecoins, or other systems handling customer value.
  • Experience building reliable APIs, event-driven workflows, transaction state machines, and idempotent systems.
  • Strong testing, monitoring, auditing, and incident-response discipline.
  • Excellent English communication.

What success looks like

Within the first months, you will have helped us launch a controlled pilot where:

  • Ihsan Gold Token is live on EVM Base.
  • Every token represents 1 gram of confirmed allocated gold.
  • Users can buy and sell only through the Ihsan app.
  • Approved users can transfer tokens to other approved users.
  • Supply, reserve balances, minting, burning, and wallet approvals are continuously auditable.
  • The team has secure procedures for operating, monitoring, and scaling the system.

Why join Ihsan

This is a founding technical role with real ownership. You will build core infrastructure for a new gold-based digital economy designed for the Ummah—not another speculative token.

You will work directly with the COO, founders, and a mission-driven team building ambitious products across messaging, payments, commerce, and Islamic finance.


How to apply

Please apply by email to vincent @ihsan.com.

Your application should include:

  • A personal message explaining why you are a strong fit.
  • Your CV and LinkedIn profile.
  • The project you have worked on that is closest to what we are building.
  • Links to relevant projects, smart contracts, GitHub repositories, audits, or technical work you have contributed to.

Is Web3 career legit?

▼

As a career, Web3 can be a legitimate and exciting field to work in, as it offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and help build the infrastructure for a more decentralized and secure internet. Web3 developers and professionals may work on projects related to decentralized finance, non-fungible tokens, decentralized autonomous organizations, and more. While the field is still relatively new and evolving, there is a growing demand for professionals with expertise in Web3, and web3 developer jobs growth are likely to increase in the coming years.

Is it hard to get a job at Web3?

▼

Jobs in crypto can be competitive, as the demand for professionals with expertise in this field has increased in recent years. However, the difficulty of finding a job in the cryptocurrency industry will depend on various factors, such as your qualifications, experience, and the specific job you are seeking. For example, if you have a strong background in computer science, finance, or economics and have relevant experience working in the cryptocurrency industry, you may have an easier time finding a job in this field. On the other hand, if you are new to the industry and do not have any relevant experience or education, it may be more challenging to break into the field. It is also worth noting that the job market in the cryptocurrency industry is constantly evolving, and the specific job opportunities available can vary significantly depending on the current state of the market.

What skills are needed for Web3?

▼

There are a variety of skills that can be beneficial to start your crypto careers in web3 projects. Some of the key skills that may be useful for Web3 professionals include: Programming skills: Web3 professionals should have strong programming skills, particularly in languages such as Solidity (for Ethereum smart contracts) and JavaScript (for building decentralized applications). Blockchain knowledge: Web3 professionals should have a solid understanding of blockchain technology and how it works. Cryptography: Familiarity with cryptographic concepts and techniques, such as hashing and digital signatures, is important for Web3 professionals. Data structures and algorithms: Web3 professionals should have a strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, as they are used extensively in blockchain technology. Networking: Web3 professionals should have a good understanding of networking concepts, as decentralized systems rely on communication between different nodes on a network. Problem-solving skills: Web3 professionals should be able to think creatively and find solutions to complex technical problems. Collaboration skills: Web3 professionals should be able to work well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues and clients.

How do I get a job with Web3 development?

▼

There are a few steps you can take to increase your chances of finding a job in Web3 development: 1. Build your skills: To work with Web3 technologies, you'll need to have a strong foundation in web development and be proficient in at least one programming language such as JavaScript, Python, or Rust. Consider taking online courses or earning a degree in a related field to gain the necessary skills. 2. Gain experience: Consider working on personal projects or contributing to open-source projects related to Web3 technologies. This will not only help you build your skills, but it will also give you something to showcase in your portfolio and during job interviews. 3. Network: Attend meetups, conferences, and other events related to Web3 technologies to meet people in the industry and learn about job opportunities. You can also reach out to Web3 developers or organizations directly to ask about internships or job openings. 4. Create a strong online presence: Make sure you have a well-written resume and LinkedIn profile that highlight your Web3 skills and experience. Consider creating a portfolio website that showcases your work and accomplishments. 5. Keep learning: The field of Web3 is constantly evolving, so it's important to stay up-to-date on the latest technologies and trends. Consider subscribing to industry publications and participating in online communities to stay current. These steps can significantly improve your chances in crypto career in web3 projects.

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain the Solidity smart contracts that govern the Ihsan Gold Token on EVM Base.
  • Create and configure the Ihsan Gold Token using secure, production-grade EVM token standards.
  • Design secure minting flows: no token may be minted until the matching gold allocation is confirmed.
  • Build secure burn and redemption flows.
  • Design a permissioned-transfer architecture, if transfers are limited to approved wallets.
  • Implement role-based access controls, allowlists or denylists, emergency pause procedures, and authority-management flows.
  • Design multisig, secure signing, key-management, and operational approval procedures.
  • Build reliable on-chain transaction flows for user-to-user transfers.
  • Ensure correct integration between the off-chain order and reserve ledger and on-chain mint and burn events.
  • Build deployment processes for testnet, staging, and mainnet.
  • Establish monitoring, indexing, alerting, reconciliation, and operational runbooks.
  • Help define the smart-contract security architecture, including independent audits and the decision between upgradeable and immutable contracts.

The core invariant

The total supply of Ihsan Gold Token must never exceed the amount of allocated physical gold held in custody.

Every mint, burn, reserve balance, wallet approval, and token supply figure must be continuously auditable.


What our wider team and partners handle

You will not be expected to build the entire financial product alone.

  • A bullion and vault partner will purchase, audit, and store the physical gold.
  • Our backend team will build broader app APIs, order flows, internal records, and operational tooling.
  • Our mobile team will build the customer experience.
  • Legal, licensing, KYC, AML, and compliance are handled separately.

Your responsibility is the secure smart-contract and token infrastructure, and its correct integration with the wider Ihsan system.


Required experience

  • Strong production experience designing and shipping secure Solidity smart contracts on EVM-compatible chains, ideally involving tokens, stablecoins, payments, wallets, or other customer-value systems.
  • Strong knowledge of ERC-20 and relevant token extensions, EVM security, wallets, transaction signing, RPC providers, and event indexing.
  • Experience implementing secure mint, burn, transfer-restriction, pause, allowlist/denylist, and role-based authority-management flows.
  • Strong understanding of multisig, MPC or hardware-backed signing, and secure key-management design.
  • Experience with financial ledgers, reconciliation, payments, wallets, stablecoins, or other systems handling customer value.
  • Experience building reliable APIs, event-driven workflows, transaction state machines, and idempotent systems.
  • Strong testing, monitoring, auditing, and incident-response discipline.
  • Excellent English communication.

What success looks like

Within the first months, you will have helped us launch a controlled pilot where:

  • Ihsan Gold Token is live on EVM Base.
  • Every token represents 1 gram of confirmed allocated gold.
  • Users can buy and sell only through the Ihsan app.
  • Approved users can transfer tokens to other approved users.
  • Supply, reserve balances, minting, burning, and wallet approvals are continuously auditable.
  • The team has secure procedures for operating, monitoring, and scaling the system.

Why join Ihsan

This is a founding technical role with real ownership. You will build core infrastructure for a new gold-based digital economy designed for the Ummah—not another speculative token.

You will work directly with the COO, founders, and a mission-driven team building ambitious products across messaging, payments, commerce, and Islamic finance.
